title: Affective / Integration Gradient — Ascent, Descent and Return
purpose: Provide a Hawkins-adjacent symbolic gradient for reading common affective/integrative tendencies across Heaven, World and Below without treating emotions as literal frequencies, objective consciousness measurements, human ranks or fixed plane membership.
boundary: The Hawkins-style scale is used only as qualitative inspiration. This project does not treat numerical consciousness/vibration values as scientifically established measurements.

bands.route: courage → stopping condition → discernment → agency → Door

laws: Ascent means increasing integration, agency, truthful relation, reciprocity and capacity—not escaping embodiment.
Descent can be healthy rooting, incarnation, grief-work, investigation or return; it is not automatically degeneration.
Degenerative descent is unresolved contraction, capture, compulsion, opacity or fragmentation.
The same person can move through several states in one day; state is not identity.
Upper affect does not prove truth; lower affect does not disprove it.
